title: Peripheral blood transcriptomics
description: This project aims to study the gene expression profiles in peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) of patients with mild and severe traumatic brain injury, construct RNA-seq libraries, and perform sequencing on the Illumina NovaSeq platform, with the goal of identifying potential biomarkers for predicting outcomes in traumatic brain injury.
